description: OS-neutral containment port (L0, crate fgos-process, module `containment`). The run supervisor never calls bwrap, Job Objects or process groups directly: it calls this port. One driver per platform. The port knows nothing about attempts, envelopes or locks beyond the attempt id used to name a domain.

domain.id: per kind, identical to predecessor.v1.json domainId so the supervisor can declare it on the attempt lock as is

create.output: a domain without processes yet; linux-gate/linux-pgroup/macos-tree: the id is completed by spawn_in (it is the root process tuple); windows-job: a named Job Object (name carries attemptId and a unique token), KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, no breakaway

spec.argv: string[] (linux-gate: the full bwrap argv including --unshare-pid --as-pid-1, ending with the gate command)
spec.fdMap: map child fd -> parent fd; every other fd >= 3 is closed in the child (spawn_with_fds of fgos-process)
spec.env: object string -> string, exact environment (no inheritance)
spec.stdio: {stdin, stdout, stderr}: each a parent fd or null (/dev/null)

spawn_in.output: hostTuple of the root process (linux-gate: the gate as pid 1 of the new namespace, read from bwrap --info-fd child-pid); the domain id is now complete

drivers.linux-gate: judge(gate hostTuple) == dead -> empty (the kernel kills and reaps every task of the namespace before init becomes a zombie); alive -> not-empty; unknown -> unknown. No ns/pid inode scan (doctor only)
drivers.linux-pgroup: no process left in the process group of the root (kill(-pgid, 0) == ESRCH) and judge(root) == dead -> empty; best-effort: a setsid descendant escapes
drivers.windows-job: OpenJobObject by name fails (job destroyed) or ActiveProcesses == 0 -> empty
drivers.macos-tree: no process in the pgid and none in the scanned descendant tree (proc_listchildpids) -> empty; best-effort: a double-forked setsid process reparented to launchd escapes

is_empty.rule: unknown is never treated as empty by a caller

kill_all.meaning: SIGTERM (or job terminate) then SIGKILL after graceMs; returns ok when is_empty == empty afterwards or the deadline passed with every process signaled; refused when the driver cannot act (identity mismatch, unsupported)

drivers.linux-gate: signal the gate by identity (pidfd); the gate is pid 1 so SIGKILL of the gate kills the namespace
drivers.linux-pgroup: killpg(pgid) by identity of the root, then scan /proc for descendants of the root and signal them
drivers.windows-job: TerminateJobObject; closing the last handle also kills (KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE); asynchronous, so the predecessor rule 6.0.1 applies

output.escapes: string[], named escape routes reported by doctor

escapes: processes created by a daemon outside the namespace on the agent's request (herdr, systemd, docker)
setsid descendants leave the process group
processes created by a service or COM server outside the job
setsid + double fork reparented to launchd (measured: survives killpg)

driverSelection: linux: linux-gate when bwrap with user and pid namespaces works (probed once per process), else linux-pgroup; windows: windows-job; macos: macos-tree; anything else: unsupported-platform
measurements: design r6 §12.7 (pid namespace), §12.10-12.12 (Windows job, macOS tree; GitHub Actions runs 38855067175, 38856358204, 38857403785)
